theme: SIP fundamentals: power of compounding, rupee cost averaging
headline: SIP: Building Wealth Through Consistent Investing
body: Invest regularly in small amounts. Time and consistency help your money grow through the power of compounding.
caption: SIP lets you invest fixed amounts at regular intervals, reducing the impact of market timing. Over time, compounding helps amplify your wealth creation potential. #SIP #CompoundingPower #RupeeCostAveraging #WealthBuilding #ConsistentInvesting
